_note: V2 only. The four KRs are finalized and computed at market grain by build_market_okr_results.py using the current central-tracking engine definitions. Company targets are intentionally not compared with individual market actuals.

selected_krs.label: Grow cumulative Pro+ CEs
selected_krs.logic: Count CEs whose trailing-92-day predicted revenue is at least $10K as of the report week.

selected_krs.label: Launch new Pro+ CEs — Mature
selected_krs.logic: Count current-quarter Mature CEs already at $10K QTD or projected to $10K using QTD plus the trailing-28-day/L4W daily run-rate over exact remaining quarter days, with maximum prior-four-quarter revenue below $10K.

selected_krs.label: Launch new Pro+ CEs — Emerging & Growth
selected_krs.logic: Count current-quarter Emerging/Growth CEs already at $10K QTD or projected to $10K using QTD plus the trailing-28-day/L4W daily run-rate over exact remaining quarter days, with maximum prior-four-quarter revenue below $10K.

selected_krs.label: Grow non-POI GEL revenue YoY
selected_krs.logic: Exact-calendar-QTD predicted revenue for non-Mature, non-POI, Managed/Managed Lite CEs versus the same month/day calendar span one year earlier.
